import pytest
from normalizer import normalize_title, normalize_tags


def test_normalize_title_whitespace_cleanup():
    assert normalize_title("  hello   world  ") == "Hello World"
    assert normalize_title("hello\t\tworld") == "Hello World"
    assert normalize_title("hello\n\nworld") == "Hello World"


def test_normalize_title_emoji_stripping():
    assert normalize_title("Hello 🌍 World") == "Hello World"
    assert normalize_title("🚀 Rocket") == "Rocket"
    assert normalize_title("🎉🎊 Party 🎈🎁") == "Party"
    assert normalize_title("No emoji here") == "No Emoji Here"


def test_normalize_tags_blank_handling():
    assert normalize_tags("a, b, c") == ["a", "b", "c"]
    assert normalize_tags("a,,b") == ["a", "b"]
    assert normalize_tags("a, , b") == ["a", "b"]
    assert normalize_tags("  a  ,  b  ") == ["a", "b"]
    assert normalize_tags("") == []
    assert normalize_tags(" , , ") == []

content.text:
All three tests pass.

- **Whitespace cleanup** — covers leading/trailing spaces, tabs, and newlines.  
- **Emoji stripping** — covers single, multiple, and no-emoji cases, and also guards against the double-space gap left by emoji removal.  
- **Blank tag handling** — covers empty strings, extra commas, blank entries, and surrounding whitespace.  

I also fixed the double-space bug in `normalize_title` that the emoji test uncovered.
